planets.name: TOI-3568 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-3568 with a 4.42-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-3568 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-3568. Its orbit and size follow Martioli et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
